source_handle: 46: Under local anesthesia with articaine, separate the gums, increase the gap, loosen the gums, remove them with forceps, scrape, apply pressure to stop bleeding, and suture. 47: Under local anesthesia with articaine, remove the decay, polish the edge of the hole, use calcium silicate as the base, fill with 3M350 resin, blend and polish; 48: Under local anesthesia with lidocaine, use local anesthesia with articaine, divide the gingiva , increase the gap, remove the resistance of the crown, loosen it, remove it with forceps, scrape, compress to stop bleeding, and suture.
